dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: This ain't gonna buy me a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: Not enough for both milk and bread, that's for certain. These days the ice-breaking tools keep wearing out in no time, and I don't know what's got into 'em. Ain't no way the Snegovik on the mountain’s gone and bewitched the ice, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: Hafta get me new tools, and they only give me a few measly coins to work with. What's that supposed to buy, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: Someone's lining their pockets, that's what it is! Hah... all the good, grease-the-palm work never comes my way.

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: Ice-breaking tools. Chisels, picks, all of it. Been giving out way too fast lately. I've been running back and forth just to get them replaced, more times than I can count.

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: Times like this, can't help but envy the Domovoy over in Novokitezhgrad. I know their Prime Ice tools work real well. Would be something if we ever got our hands on those.

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: Eh, not gonna stick around and chat a bit? Alright then. See ya.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound right to me though.

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: Of course not. Especially when the one lining their pockets ain't me. That makes it all the worse.

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: ...*Sigh* Still, maybe that guy will end up getting burned by it one of these days. Dirty money always brings trouble down on your head. It's just a matter of time.
